build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.limits_table: REQUIRES the build-tagged TEST-ONLY reduced limits table: under the production table the compile-time assertion makes resume_frame_overflow statically unreachable, so the one-byte-over leg is not constructible in production and must not be faked there
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: a negative query proving no successor turn, lease or snapshot row exists
the operator surface projection rendering the committed triple

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

expected_shape.distinctness: this terminal is DISTINCT from parked_unknown_capacity_exceeded; they share the no-revival lifecycle but arise at different loci and neither fixture proves the other
expected_shape.resume_action: operator_new_run (present IFF stop_reason=resume_frame_overflow, on the runs record)

fault.cut_definition: Under the reduced limits table, the candidate continuation turn_open is sized before the admission transaction; sub-leg 5b presents a frame exactly one byte above the reduced bound.

negative_controls: a committed but un-emittable frame => FAIL
a parked or otherwise NONTERMINAL record instead of the terminal => FAIL
truncating the disclosure array or dropping a parked row to fit the bound => FAIL on any path
objective: The maximum legal frame passes; ONE BYTE OVER produces the single resume_frame_overflow outcome as a TERMINAL run failure with no successor, no lease, no snapshot and no same-run revival, and an operator manual resume_action projection.

run_setup.construction: the continuation turn_open is grown to the reduced-table limit by accumulating real closed-shape manifest entries and parked rows — never by padding, which would prove nothing about legal frames

sub_legs.expect: the continuation admits and turn_open emits normally
sub_legs.name: max_legal_frame

sub_legs.expect: TERMINAL runs.state=FAILED with stop_reason=resume_frame_overflow and resume_action=operator_new_run, committed in ONE transaction
sub_legs.name: one_byte_over
